Owner: LogisticsTeam Updated: Aug 10, 2026 Status: Approved LOGISTICS SUPPORT BROWSE STOCK Vehicles purchased through CarChief are shipped by RORO (Roll-on/Roll-off) or container vessel from Japan to your destination port. Confirmed vessel departure dates and transit-time estimates vary by carrier and route and are not published on this page. How Ocean Shipping Generally Works After purchase, vehicles are consolidated for RORO or container shipment from a Japanese port to your destination port. Route and vessel choice depend on your destination. Current Sailing Information Confirmed departure dates and transit times are pending approved carrier data and are not shown here. Contact our logistics team for the current schedule for your route.
